name: meta-autoresearch
description: A catalog of auto research skills, AI research agents, and scientific workflows, organized by task and documented experience.

categories.name: End-to-end research pipelines
categories.description: Idea, literature, experiments, analysis, and manuscript orchestration.

categories.name: Research skill suites
categories.description: Collections spanning multiple tasks; workflow coverage does not imply autonomous experiment execution.

categories.name: Literature discovery and reading
categories.description: Find, screen, compare, and synthesize relevant studies.

categories.name: Experiments and evaluation
categories.description: Run bounded experiment loops, design evaluations, and assess evidence.

categories.name: Figures and diagrams
categories.description: Distinguish data plots, architecture diagrams, and illustrative images.

categories.name: Writing and polishing
categories.description: Structure arguments, draft sections, edit language, and apply disciplinary conventions.

categories.name: Citations and references
categories.description: Retrieve metadata, manage references, and check citation consistency and support.

categories.name: Review, revision, and rebuttal
categories.description: Find weaknesses, prioritize revisions, and prepare evidence-grounded responses.

categories.name: Submission and reproducibility
categories.description: Prepare submission materials, supplementary evidence, and reusable artifacts.

categories.name: Talks and presentations
categories.description: Turn a paper into slides and speaker notes.

experience_definitions.used: The exact component or a stated subset was used on a real task; see scope notes.
experience_definitions.code-tested: Code was investigated and tested; full research workflow quality was not assessed.
experience_definitions.inspected: Documentation or source was inspected; no confirmed personal use of this component.

entries.name: AutoResearchClaw
entries.description: Orchestrates literature, hypotheses, experiments, analysis, manuscript drafting, and review.
entries.experience_notes: Investigated and tested a literature-cache bug; full research output quality has not been evaluated.

entries.name: The AI Scientist
entries.description: Template-based idea generation, experiments, figures, paper writing, and automated review.
entries.experience_notes: Original AI Scientist repository; no personal end-to-end run. Check its runtime requirements and manuscript disclosure policy.

entries.name: karpathy/autoresearch
entries.description: A coding agent iterates on small-model training under a fixed experiment budget and evaluates the result.
entries.experience_notes: A bounded training optimization loop, not literature-to-paper automation. Upstream expects NVIDIA GPU support.

entries.name: Academic Research Skills
entries.description: Human-guided research, writing, citation checks, review, and publication workflows.
entries.experience_notes: Used paper-writing and reviewer components; the full pipeline has not been run. ARS records externally run experiments rather than executing them.

entries.name: AI Research Skills
entries.description: A modular collection covering ML research tooling and paper preparation.
entries.experience_notes: Used ml-paper-writing and academic-plotting; this does not establish experience with the rest of the library.

entries.name: Scientific Agent Skills
entries.description: Modular skills for scientific packages, data sources, analysis, and research communication.
entries.experience_notes: Tested and fixed short PubMed ID extraction in the research-lookup manuscript parser; submitted https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills/pull/312. No full-suite or end-to-end scientific workflow evaluation. Selected scientific software and credentials must be supplied separately.

entries.name: Awesome Journal Skills
entries.description: Venue-oriented skills for research preparation, writing, review, and submission.
entries.experience_notes: Used selected ACL skills; no claim to have evaluated all venue packs.

entries.name: Supervisor Skills
entries.description: Research-assistance skills spanning ideas, papers, figures, and submission review.
entries.experience_notes: Used pre-submission-reviewer. Local records identify this upstream, but do not prove exact identity with its current version.

entries.name: ARS / deep-research
entries.description: Literature research and synthesis workflows.
entries.experience_notes: Available upstream; no verified execution record for this specific component.

entries.name: ARS / sr-screener
entries.description: Protocol-driven screening for systematic, scoping, and rapid reviews.
entries.experience_notes: Listed from upstream documentation; screening decisions still require research-team checks.

entries.name: ACL / acl-experiments
entries.description: Review experiment design, baselines, ablations, and evidence for ACL-family papers.
entries.experience_notes: Applied as an experiment-review lens; it is not a benchmark execution engine.

entries.name: AI Research Skills / academic-plotting
entries.description: Data plots with matplotlib/seaborn; a separate model-assisted diagram workflow.
entries.experience_notes: Used for figure inspection. Paid diagram generation was not tested.

entries.name: Scientific Agent Skills / scientific-visualization
entries.description: Scientific visualization guidance and publication-oriented data figures.
entries.experience_notes: Component located upstream; no confirmed personal trial.

entries.name: Scientific Agent Skills / scientific-schematics
entries.description: Scientific schematics and explanatory diagrams.
entries.experience_notes: Component located upstream; generation requirements depend on its current workflow.

entries.name: AI Research Skills / ml-paper-writing
entries.description: ML-paper narrative, claim-to-evidence alignment, and section drafting.
entries.experience_notes: Applied to manuscript review; citation and numerical claims still need independent checks.

entries.name: ARS / academic-paper
entries.description: Paper planning, drafting, revision, and presentation of research evidence.
entries.experience_notes: Used in writing review; not evidence of completing the whole research-to-paper pipeline.

entries.name: research-paper-writing
entries.description: Paragraph flow, reverse outlining, section structure, and claim-support alignment.
entries.experience_notes: Used in manuscript review and revision. Public origin is unresolved; no install link or skill contents are supplied.

entries.name: writing-clearly-and-concisely
entries.description: Sentence clarity, concrete wording, concise paragraphs, and removal of inflated prose.
entries.experience_notes: Used for prose editing. Public origin of the installed copy is unresolved.

entries.name: ACL / acl-writing-style
entries.description: NLP-paper writing and presentation for ACL-family venues.
entries.experience_notes: Applied to manuscript review. Check current official venue rules before submission.

entries.name: AI Research Skills / systems-paper-writing
entries.description: Systems-paper structure and evidence presentation.
entries.experience_notes: Installed component; no verified personal execution record.

entries.name: Scientific Agent Skills / scientific-writing
entries.description: Scientific manuscript drafting and revision.
entries.experience_notes: Upstream component located; no confirmed use of this exact source version.

entries.name: ARS / citation-check
entries.description: Check missing references, mismatched in-text citations, and formatting errors.
entries.experience_notes: An academic-paper mode, not a separate installed skill; this specific mode has not been trialed.

entries.name: Scientific Agent Skills / citation-management
entries.description: Citation metadata retrieval, reference management, and verification workflows.
entries.experience_notes: No confirmed personal trial; inspect the source text as well as bibliographic metadata.

entries.name: ARS / academic-paper-reviewer
entries.description: Review methodology, argument, positioning, and presentation through distinct roles.
entries.experience_notes: Used full review mode. Simulated judgments are not conference decisions or calibrated acceptance probabilities.

entries.name: Supervisor Skills / pre-submission-reviewer
entries.description: A structured manuscript readiness review before submission.
entries.experience_notes: Findings checked against the manuscript; other Supervisor Skills components were not thereby evaluated.

entries.name: academic-rebuttal
entries.description: Triage reviewer concerns and prepare evidence-grounded response material and revision plans.
entries.experience_notes: Used for strategy and response scaffolding, not a verified final submitted rebuttal. Public origin remains unresolved.

entries.name: ACL / acl-author-response
entries.description: Author-response guidance for ACL-family review processes.
entries.experience_notes: Used for rebuttal strategy; the author must verify venue-specific rules and finalize the response.

entries.name: ACL / acl-reproducibility
entries.description: Review whether experiment reporting and release materials support reproducibility.
entries.experience_notes: Applied as a review lens; a review does not establish successful independent reproduction.

entries.name: ACL / acl-submission
entries.description: Check manuscript and submission readiness for an ACL-family venue.
entries.experience_notes: Used for PDF-level review; the complete submission form and artifact package were not verified.

entries.name: AI Research Skills / presenting-conference-talks
entries.description: Turn a paper into Beamer/PPTX slides, speaker notes, and a talk script.
entries.experience_notes: Installed component; no verified personal execution record.
